+title: Delete the unused RoutedSession.fork
+---
+## What
+
+Delete the unused session fork. Nothing in any package calls `RoutedSession.fork(workingDirectory:)` (checked 2026-10-24 across every `Sources/` in `swissarmyhammer/`). The ACP agent does not implement ACP's unstable `session/fork`. If fork comes back later, build it from the parent's current rendered context as the start message of the new session (the user's design, 2026-10-24).
+
+- [ ] Delete `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Session/RoutedSessionActorForking.swift` and the requirement `fork(workingDirectory:)` in `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Session/RoutedSession.swift:580`, with each conformer and stub.
+- [ ] `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Session/SessionHooks.swift:22, 96, 279`: remove the `.fork` case and its `SessionStart` source, if nothing else makes it. If the case is a public type of FoundationModelsHooks, keep it there and remove only Router's use. Say which in the commit.
+- [ ] Remove the helpers that only fork uses, for example `TranscriptTree.forkPrefix` (`Recording/TranscriptTree.swift:335`) and `settledTranscript` / `SettledTranscript.removingUnansweredCalls()` if no other code reads them. Check each with `rg` before you delete it.
+- [ ] Remove the fork tests (`ForkConcurrencyTests` and the others that `rg -n fork Tests` finds).
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] `rg -n 'func fork|\.fork\(' Sources` finds nothing in Router.
+- [ ] Router builds, and FoundationModelsACPAgent builds against it.
+- [ ] No test is left that names a fork.
+
+## Tests
+
+- [ ] `swift test` in FoundationModelsRouter: all tests pass, with no new warnings.
+- [ ] `swift build` in FoundationModelsACPAgent with this Router: it succeeds.
+
+## Workflow
+
+- A delete: the build and the present tests are the proof. Commit it on its own. #no-queue
\ No newline at end of file
